# Real NixOS system closure, captured from an EC2 host running the official
# nixos/26.05.9592.21a67dc47014-x86_64-linux AMI:
#
#   nix-store --query --requisites /run/current-system \
#     | while IFS= read -r p; do [ -d "$p" ] && printf '%s\n' "$p"; done
#
# The full closure is 681 store paths, 566 of them directories. This is a
# curated subset of those directories: every output of a handful of packages,
# so the multi-output collapse is exercised on real names; both shapes of
# generated systemd unit directory; the generation itself, the initrd and the
# kernel; and a spread of the rest.
#
# The 115 non-directories are left out because the command does not emit them:
# NixOS builds generated configuration into the store as plain files
# (etc-sysctl.d-60-nixos.conf, etc-systemd-system-preset-00-nixos.preset),
# and those are not installed packages.
